acceptance_and_claim_policy: Coverage below 80% is reported as insufficient and is never silently backfilled.
Report both overlays even if one or both reduce Sharpe or CAGR.
No outcome-aware delta, DTE, strategy, or sizing changes are permitted in the primary run.
The options overlay is a club research extension, not a recommendation to trade options or invest personal money.

metrics: active information ratio versus ETF underlying

locked_costs_and_request_budget.request_plan: at most one entry chain and one exit chain for each of 59 monthly observations

locked_entry_and_exit.assessment_entries: last trading-day close of each month from 2021-01 through 2025-11
locked_entry_and_exit.exit: next month-end close using the exact same ticker, expiration, strike, and option side
locked_entry_and_exit.expired_contract: intrinsic value from SPY close on expiration or the last available trading close before expiration
locked_entry_and_exit.substitution: no nearby-strike, expiration, ticker, or date substitution

collar.purpose: finance downside protection by capping upside

locked_underlying_and_sizing.hedge_ratio: ETF basket beta to SPY estimated once using monthly 2013-07-18 through 2019-12-31 returns
locked_underlying_and_sizing.notional: one SPY-share-equivalent per beta-adjusted ETF portfolio notional; fractional-contract economics for research
